headline: Claim Devaughn Vele (bid 9) before Wednesday's 12:05 AM PT waiver run, then move A.J. Brown to IR once he unlocks Tuesday morning.
summary: Week 1 is almost entirely locked; only Jaylen Waddle's Monday night game at KC (5:15 PM PT) hasn't kicked off, and there's no unlocked bench WR to swap him with, so the lineup is set. The only real moves left are the Tuesday IR shift for A.J. Brown (confirmed out ~6 weeks, high ankle sprain) and a waiver claim on Saints WR Devaughn Vele, who looked like a real weekly piece in Week 1.

adds.why: tier 2, bid 9 of your 145 left: clear #2 WR role behind Olave with rookie Jordyn Tyson out at least 4 weeks; the IR move frees the roster spot before this claim processes.
adds.evidence: Vele: 7 catches on 9 targets, 69 yards and a TD in Week 1 vs DET (NBC/Yahoo, Sep 13-14); Olave banged up (cramps/back) in the same game, pushing more work to Vele; Tyson (hamstring) opened the season on IR, out 4+ weeks, so the target share behind Olave is Vele's for a while, not a committee.

ir.why: Locked until Tuesday morning (his game is already complete but the week hasn't rolled over); confirmed high ankle sprain, expected out about 6 weeks with no surgery (Boston.com/Ian Rapoport, Sep 13), so IR rather than a drop.

flags.what: Inactive Week 1, high ankle sprain, expected out ~6 weeks (reported Sep 13)
Bucky Irving is TB's clear lead back (35-26 snaps, 7-1 targets in Wk 1, reported Sep 13); Gainwell is now a pass-catching change-of-pace piece, an uncertain FLEX going forward
Today's room shows him as GB's active RB1 with Josh Jacobs still on the Commissioner's Exempt List (legal matter, no return date); Lloyd played the lead role in Week 1

watch.what: Green Bay's presumptive lead back with Jacobs away indefinitely on the exempt list; re-check his role before setting Week 2's FLEX over Gainwell or Judkins
Losing the early-down/goal-line work to Irving; watch the Week 2 snap split before starting him again
Still a real committee with Jordan Mason (Mason had thumb X-rays after Wk 1, not described as serious yet); only worth an add over Tucker if Mason is ruled out
Burrow and Willis share the week-6 bye; no free-agent starting QB with a different bye is available yet, keep checking the wire

alerts.title: ➕ Claim Vele before Wed 12:05 AM
alerts.body: Bid 9 on Devaughn Vele (NO) — 9 targets, TD in Week 1, clear #2 role with Tyson out. Claim processes Wed 12:05 AM PT; the spot opens once A.J. Brown moves to IR Tuesday.

alerts.title: 🔴 Move A.J. Brown to IR Tuesday AM
alerts.body: Confirmed high ankle sprain, out ~6 weeks. He's locked until the week rolls over Tuesday morning — move him to IR then, not before.

alerts.title: 🟢 Lloyd now GB's lead back
alerts.body: Jacobs remains on the exempt list with no return date. Lloyd played the RB1 role in Week 1 — consider him over Gainwell/Judkins for Week 2's FLEX.
